subject: E-Commerce
title: The Search Engine of Shopping
description: A fast breakdown of The Search Engine of Shopping for builders.

hook.text: 63% of US product searches start on Amazon, not Google. Amazon replaced Google as the shopping search engine.

buildup.text: When people want to research a product, they go to Amazon for reviews, prices, and availability—even if they buy.

discovery.text: Google responded by adding Shopping tabs, product comparisons, and review aggregators. It's fighting to stay relevant.

twist.text: TikTok is now the starting point for product discovery among Gen Z. Neither Google nor Amazon starts the journey.

climax.text: The 'starting point' for shopping keeps shifting. Whoever owns the first search owns the entire purchase funnel.

punchline.text: 63% search Amazon first. The search engine of shopping isn't Google.

quiz.question: Where do 63% of US product searches begin?
